prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one opaque wide 2:1 background plate for the NPC relationship and dialogue stage of the Chinese xianxia idle game 尘缘问道. This is production environment art, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: a refined hand-painted ancient Chinese scholar's receiving pavilion, calm and intimate, painted in the same detailed atmospheric wuxia/fantasy style as a misty mountain cave dwelling. No characters: four existing transparent character busts and all text/actions will be composed by the game later.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet open wooden pavilion with an aged dark teal timber screen, elegant bamboo at the edges, a distant misty mountain garden through the open lattice on the far left, a restrained warm lantern high at the far right. A plain low dark wood meeting table crosses the lower foreground, without any objects on it. Fine ink-wash mountains and worn wood, restrained painterly realism rather than a flat graphic.
Composition/framing: landscape 2:1. The left quarter and lower left are visually calm, moderately dark, and clear for a large foreground NPC bust. Keep the central and right middle two-thirds quiet with broad readable dark jade shadow, subtle depth and soft paper-screen texture, with no busy furniture, frames or strong luminous highlights behind the future dialogue. Table is only along the bottom edge, below the reading area. No painted interface borders or inset panels. This is an illustrative meeting mood, not a new named map location.
Lighting/mood: diffuse cool daylight from the garden, gentle warm edge light, very subtle dust-free still air; peaceful and grounded, no magic effects, no fire or smoke.
Color palette: ink blue, deep jade green and muted pine green, dark weathered timber, restrained antique gold accents. Preserve rich midtone detail instead of crushing everything to black; avoid pale yellow parchment expanses.
Text: none.
Constraints: no people, faces, silhouettes, figures or reflections of people; no text, symbols, calligraphy, logos, watermark, UI, windows, menus, counters or buttons. No pills, weapons, relics, coins, books, letters, brushes, stamps, teapots, cups, magical particles or loot. No scenery baked into a frame. Full-bleed clean opaque background, no transparency. One complete coherent painted environment.
